sloka: तांश्चैव सर्वान् स हरीन् शरैः सर्वायसैर्बली।विव्याधाभिमुखः सङ्ख्ये भीमकायो निशाचरः ।। ६.७१.४१ ।।
transliteration: tāṁścaiva sarvān sa harīn śaraiḥ sarvāyasairbalī।vivyādhābhimukhaḥ saṅkhye bhīmakāyo niśācaraḥ ।। 6.71.41 ।।

translations.english: The powerful night ranger of terrible form, pierced all monkeys who were facing him in the battlefield with iron arrows.
